povzetek: Brez moke in dodanega sladkorja — konzerva fižola, datlji in proteini; 33 min na 180 °C.
opis: Za {kolicina} — ena porcija je ena konzerva fižola, da gre cela v delo. Sladijo samo datlji, moke ni. Beri po vrsticah: sestavine levo, postopek se pomika v desno.
predgretje: Pečico ogrej na 180 °C — zgornji + spodnji grelec

sestavine.ime: sadje po želji — jagode, banana, borovnice

koraki.besedilo:
v posodi
zblendaj
v gladko zmes

v pekač,
sadje vmešaj in/ali
dodaj po vrhu +
potresi čokolado

opombe: Ena porcija je ena konzerva fižola: konzerva ima 400 g, odcejenega ostane cca. 240 g. Preračun je zastavljen tako, da vedno porabiš cele konzerve.
Fižol odcedi in dobro splakni, sicer se pozna okus konzerve.
Če so datlji presuhi, jih pred blendanjem nekaj minut prevri v vodi in odcedi.
Vse sestavine daj v eno posodo in zblendaj s paličnim mešalnikom, dokler zmes ni popolnoma gladka — koščki fižola se v pečici ne zmehčajo.
Sadje lahko vmešaš v zmes, položiš po vrhu ali oboje. Na nakupovalnem seznamu je sadje samo predlog (jagode, banane, borovnice) — obkljukaj, kar rabiš.
Preračun v žlice: 1 slaba merica proteinov ≈ 25 g, 1 čajna žlička pecilnega praška ≈ 4 g, 1 žlica kakava ≈ 7 g, 1/3 tablice čokolade ≈ 35 g.
Pekač 20 × 30 cm, obložen s papirjem za peko. Pri drugačni količini izberi pekač tako, da ostane zmes enako debela — 33 min na 180 °C potem drži.
Pusti, da se popolnoma ohladi, preden razrežeš; vroči se drobijo. V hladilniku zdržijo 3–4 dni.

en.povzetek: No flour and no added sugar — a can of beans, dates and protein powder; 33 min at 180 °C.
en.opis: For {kolicina} — one batch is one can of beans, so the whole can gets used. Only the dates sweeten them; there is no flour. Read row by row: ingredients on the left, the method moves to the right.
en.predgretje: Preheat the oven to 180 °C — top and bottom heat

sestavine.ime: drained red kidney beans ({n} × 400 g can)
fruit of your choice — strawberries, banana, blueberries

koraki:
blend
in a bowl
until smooth

into the tin,
fold in fruit and/or
add it on top +
sprinkle chocolate
opombe: One batch is one can of beans: a can holds 400 g, about 240 g once drained. The scaling is set up so that you always use whole cans.
Drain the beans and rinse them well, otherwise you can taste the can.
If the dates are too dry, simmer them in water for a few minutes before blending and drain them.
Put all the ingredients in one bowl and blend with a stick blender until completely smooth — bits of bean don't soften in the oven.
The fruit can be folded into the mixture, laid on top, or both. On the shopping list the fruit is only a suggestion (strawberries, bananas, blueberries) — tick what you need.
Spoon conversion: 1 scant scoop of protein ≈ 25 g, 1 tsp baking powder ≈ 4 g, 1 tbsp cocoa ≈ 7 g, 1/3 of a chocolate bar ≈ 35 g.
Tin 20 × 30 cm, lined with baking paper. For a different quantity choose a tin that keeps the mixture the same depth — then 33 min at 180 °C still holds.
Let them cool completely before cutting; warm, they crumble. They keep for 3–4 days in the fridge.
